transcript.text: After reviewing this morning's callback footage, I can confirm that Sable is the only shortlisted performer who can sing the principal arrangement while executing its required eight-count movement sequence. Rowan and Tessa were unable to meet both the vocal and movement requirements simultaneously. This finding has not yet been circulated to casting until now. I'm formally submitting this as my final callback report for the casting package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share an important contractual matter with the group. Sable's signed engagement rider requires the production to name Rowan as the understudy for the principal vocal role. I received the countersigned rider today but have not yet entered it in the casting file. Additionally, Rowan is already cleared under the same vocal and publicity terms as Sable's rider. This is relevant because if Sable is selected as our lead performer, we are contractually obligated to name Rowan as the named understudy.
